subject: Request: SAML session lifetimes, STS token leases, and SCIM sync evidence
messages:
From: Jamie Liao <ciso@meditech.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: SAML session lifetimes + STS leases + SCIM deltas

Hi Mina,

We are working through the SIG questionnaire and need artifact-level answers for a few IAM controls before next Tuesday's audit call. Can you provide the following?

1) SAML assertion examples and the configured session timeout values for the Hosted API (including any org-level overrides).
2) STS token lifetime policies (short-lived credentials) you issue for private/dedicated connectors and any automatic refresh behavior.
3) SCIM provisioning sync logs showing delta events for group and role assignments for the last 30 days (anonymized is fine).
4) A short summary of RBAC enforcement (how role->capability mapping is stored) and any automated role pruning or entitlement review cadence.

If you prefer, we can accept: a) a small packet of sample assertions + policy snippets, b) a CSV of SCIM events, and c) a 1-page narrative. Please let us know by EOD Friday if you'll be able to turn this around or if we should schedule a quick call.

Thanks,
Jamie Liao
CISO, Meditech Solutions

--
Attachment: requested_controls_template.xlsx (we attached a completed questionnaire fragment)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Liao <ciso@meditech.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SAML session lifetimes + STS leases + SCIM deltas

Hi Jamie,

Thanks for the clear list — we can deliver this. Quick notes:
- We'll include three SAML assertion examples (redacted PII) and the runtime session timeout defaults. We have both global defaults and per-tenant overrides; I'll call out which packages are used for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.
- STS policy: short-lived tokens are issued by our token broker; default lease is 1 hour for ephemeral agent creds, refresh allowed only via a rotation endpoint (no long-lived static tokens).
- SCIM: we can export a 30-day delta CSV. We'll redact user emails but keep role/group ids and timestamps.
- RBAC: we store role -> capability mappings in our config service; entitlement reviews run quarterly and we can attach the last review document.

I'll coordinate with infra for logs. CC'ing Jonas (compliance) and Vivek (infra) to help collect the artifacts and produce the one-page narrative for SIG review.

Target delivery: Friday EOD (2026-07-16). If you need anything sooner, flag it here.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

--
(attachment placeholder: scim-sync-log-20260630.csv)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SAML session lifetimes + STS leases + SCIM deltas

Mina / Vivek —

I pulled the SCIM delta export for the last 30 days from the provisioning service. It's a CSV with the following columns: event_time, event_type (create/update/patch/disable), actor_id (internal admin id), external_id (anonymized user id), group_id, role_assignment. Sample rows look like: 
2026-06-20T14:03:12Z,patch,svc-provisioner-3,anon-usr-023,grp-analytics,role-readonly

Vivek — please attach the SAML assertion examples and the STS policy snippet (token policy file). Also flag whether any tenants have non-standard session_timeouts so Mina can enumerate them.

I'll prepare the brief RBAC narrative (3 bullets) and include a pointer to the last quarterly entitlement review (doc id HS-321) in the packet.

-Jonas
Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference

(attachment placeholder: scim-sync-log-20260630.csv)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Liao <ciso@meditech.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SAML session lifetimes + STS leases + SCIM deltas

Jamie,

Thanks for waiting — attached is a small evidence packet for your SIG intake:

- scim-sync-log-20260630.csv (30-day delta export; user identifiers anonymized, includes timestamps and role assignments)
- saml-assertion-examples.txt (three redacted SAML assertions showing Audience, NameID format, AuthnContext and NotOnOrAfter stamps)
- sts-token-policy.yaml (policy excerpt showing default ttl: 3600s and enforced rotation rules)
- rbac-summary.txt (3-bullet narrative describing role->capability store, enforcement at API gateway, and quarterly entitlement review cadence)

Notes:
- Hosted API default session timeout: 8 hours (web console sessions).
- API service-to-service SAML sessions generally leverage STS tokens with 1-hour leases; longer live sessions are not issued.
- Two customers in Dedicated tier have custom session_timeouts configured (Customer A: 12h, Customer B: 4h). Those are tenant-level settings; we included a short table in rbac-summary.txt.

If you want, we can redact further columns or provide a short Zoom next Monday to walk through the artifacts.

Best regards,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: saml-assertion-examples.txt, sts-token-policy.yaml, rbac-summary.txt, scim-sync-log-20260630.csv
